__task_filterVehicles()

[ui-task] re-fetches all vehicles from the db, then uses a FilterVehiclesDialog() to construct a VehicleFilterOptions(), which is used to determine which of the fetched vehicles should be shown in the __dbRecordView.

Return type:

None
